evals.prompt: Write me a Facebook post for Negosyante PH about the upcoming 1701Q deadline. I want it to be genuinely helpful — teach them something, don't just advertise AKBai. The deadline is April 15.
evals.expected_output: A Taglish FB value post following the teach-first formula: hook about the 1701Q deadline, educational body with specific BIR details (forms, penalties, what to prepare), BIR disclaimer, and a soft CTA. Should feel like a peer helping peers, not a brand posting an ad.

evals.prompt: I need to position AKBai against Taxumo in a blog post. Not a takedown — I respect what they do. But I want MSME owners to understand why AKBai is different. Help me write the comparison section.
evals.expected_output: A respectful competitive comparison in Taglish that acknowledges Taxumo's strengths (tax filing, eFPS integration), then positions AKBai's differentiation: integrated 5-pillar suite vs tax-only, ₱399 vs ₱499-999 pricing, Taglish-native vs English-dominant. Real numbers, no trash-talk.

evals.prompt: Draft a 5-email waitlist nurture sequence for AKBai. I want each email to teach something useful — not just hype. These are Filipino MSME owners who signed up because they're interested in BIR help and business tools.
evals.expected_output: A 5-email sequence over ~14 days. Each email has a Taglish subject line, teaches something genuinely useful (BIR tips, expense tracking advice, founder story), and builds toward launch anticipation. Katuwang voice throughout — warm, specific, never salesy. Includes BIR disclaimer where relevant.
